explication: Ragas is an evaluation framework for RAG and LLM applications. A developer invokes the SDK or CLI with an evaluation dataset; experiments execute metrics over application outputs, using prompts and model providers to produce scores and reasons. Datasets can be loaded through backends, while separate test-set generation builds knowledge graphs, transforms them, and synthesizes scenarios. Optimizers, callbacks, caching, and framework integrations extend the evaluation and improvement loop. Some subsystem links are inferred from documented capabilities because only sampled source excerpts were available.
